# From an acquired response law to later certified control

1 November 2026. Root construction, with a separate mathematical challenge in
`../physical/CONSUMER_REVIEW.md`. All prior Astra premises are pinned to
`51ce47ce39f976517d60e2f87bbe280b651f6056`.

## 1. Physical and information contract

Normalize the admitted fixed response to

    f(x)=h^T P(I+PCP)^(-1)Ph,
    P=diag(sqrt(x)), C>=0, C_ii<=q, |h_i|<=1,
    X={x>=0: sum x_i<=1}.

Its underlying physical gain is F(u)=L f(u/delta), L=delta G^2,
q=delta kappa. A single calibration event supplies an acquired rational
function hatf or the LP interval service with sup_X|hatf-f|<=zeta. Any one
feasible fitted ratio satisfies this when the whole-interval width is <=zeta.
Future commands, prices and constraint sets may be selected after the record.
This is static control of the same fixed source, with the same admissible dose
language. It is not a theorem for unknown evolving dynamics or new actuators.

The later task is to maximize f(x)-c.x over a supplied nonempty compact convex
set K contained in X. The price c is known. K comes with a feasible starting
point and an actual finite-cost linear optimization oracle. No arbitrary
nonconvex planner is assumed. Outputs are an intervention and a regret bound.

## 2. Concavity and curvature belong to the real source

Choose Gram vectors b_i with C_ij=b_i.b_j. They are proof objects, not acquired
data. Woodbury gives

    f(x)=min_z [||z||^2 + sum_i x_i(h_i-b_i.z)^2].        (1)

As the infimum of affine functions of x, f is concave. The minimizing z is
unique because its Hessian in z is positive definite. Put

    A_x=I+sum_i x_i b_i b_i^T, z_x=A_x^(-1)sum_i x_i h_i b_i,
    v_i=h_i-b_i.z_x.

The envelope derivative and its Hessian are

    partial_i f=v_i^2,
    partial_ij f=-2 v_i v_j b_i^T A_x^(-1)b_j.           (2)

Taking z=0 in (1) shows f<=sum x_i h_i^2<=1. Hence ||z_x||<=1,
|v_i|<=1+sqrt(q), and A_x>=I gives

    |partial_ij f|<=2q(1+sqrt(q))^2.                   (3)

Every difference between two points of X has l1 norm <=2. Therefore along
every segment from x to y in X the absolute second derivative is at most

    Ccurv=8q(1+sqrt(q))^2.                            (4)

These bounds include singular C and all dark couplings. The coefficients of
an LP-feasible rational fit need not define a concave function. Only f is
used in (1)--(4).

# Scoped independent review: scalar-only offline control certificates

2026-11-01. Reviewed `../control/control_demo.py` and independently validated
its saved certificates. No historical novelty, physical experiment, or
large-system performance claim is assessed here.

## Verdict and actual scope

PASS for the declared normalized source contract and four released tasks.
The exact algebraic dual-certificate and global concavity-regret arguments
are sound. The independent checker consumed only:

* `../control/results/scalar_records.json`;
* `../control/results/dual_certificates.json`;
* explicit public specifications n=3,r=3,k=6,q=4,delta=G=1,eta=10^-6 and the
  four task cost/cap/budget definitions.

It did not import `control_demo.py`, read B or g, read the demo's source-truth
diagnostics, call a numerical optimizer, or use any floating value to decide
a certificate. Files:

* `validate_control_certificates.py`;
* `independent_control_validation.json`.

All 84 supplied settings were checked to be exactly the complete degree-six
simplex lattice, without duplicates. All 32 rational dual certificates were
validated. The exact task regrets, displayed as decimals, were:

| Task | Certified global regret |
|---|---:|
| All controls | 0.000013566046254835413 |
| Changed prices | 0.000019372492589270274 |
| Actuator 2 unavailable | 0.000008553456130896513 |
| Half budget | 0.0000023465831286934903 |

The largest exact dual residual-box repair was 219/25000000000000. The receipt
retains exact Fraction values for every conclusion. No source calls are
needed by this validation or by the four offline consumers.

## 1. Source isolation checked in the executable

`run()` uses B,g to generate the simulated scalar readings and to check
known-source diagnostics after proposal/certification. `IntervalLearner`
receives only n,r,q and the scalar records. Its constructor builds coefficient
boxes and observation constraints solely from those inputs. `propose_value`,
`certify_ratio`, `interval`, and `gradients` do not access B,g or the source
determinant coefficients. The learner's floating fit is not claimed feasible
by exact arithmetic; it is only a proposal source. That does not affect the
subsequent certificates.
